PRESTIGE.s: Prestige Estates ne Prestige Vaishnaoi Projects me 4.59% extra hissedari Rs 110.9 cr me kharidi.
Prestige Falcon ne Advent Convention me 50% stake liya, Mumbai commercial project ki GDV Rs 4,500 crore hai.

BHARATFORG.s: Bharat Forge ki subsidiary Ferrovia Transrail ka BF Infrastructure me merger NCLT manzoori ke baad poora hua.

HEROMOTOCO.s: Punjab High Court ne Hero MotoCorp ke bank account lien ko radd kiya, ESIC ko Rs 4.80 crore refund karne ka aadesh diya.
